summary: ResumeStudio is an offline-first career workspace. Your drafts and career records stay on your device by default. Optional sync, connected AI, live spoken interviews and hosted sharing have different data flows, described below, and run when you choose those features.
features: Structured editing, import, ATS readiness, Recruiter Scan, 181 résumé templates, Layout Studio, searchable PDF and editable DOCX export.
Capture job adverts, track applications, connect documents and contacts, schedule interviews, compare offers, and act on a focused Today queue.
On-device assistance handles suitable lightweight work. Higher-quality connected AI powers complex tailoring, interview plans, cover letters, and Career Coach workflows.
privacyBullets: Drafts, applications, evidence and saved interview work are stored on device first.
Selected screenshots and scanned documents can be read locally with Apple Vision.
Connected writing uses limited redacted context. AI import and live spoken interviews have separate, explicit data flows.
There is no advertising, data sale or cross-app advertising tracking. Optional product insights are off by default.
Local, iCloud, hosted and account data have separate export and deletion controls.

privacySections.title: Data stored on your device
paragraphs: Your device stores résumé documents and photos, versions, layouts, cover letters, applications, selected contacts, offers, interview history, career evidence and attached source files, imported inbox items, AI results, coach conversations and remembered context, Writing Voice Profile samples, preferences and verified offline purchase access.

Importing a selected contact does not upload your entire address book. Messages, screenshots, documents and calendar invitations shared into the Application Inbox are analyzed locally for your review before any proposed workspace change is applied.

privacySections.title: On-device intelligence and OCR
paragraphs: Apple Vision can read selected images, screenshots and scanned documents on your device. On supported Apple Intelligence devices, suitable lightweight tasks may use Apple’s on-device Foundation Models framework. Content handled entirely on device is not sent to ResumeStudio’s backend or OpenAI.

Availability depends on the device and system settings. Connected fallback is a separate setting and may use the credits shown for the action. You can pause AI in Privacy Centre. A local OCR preview and a connected AI import are separate choices.

privacySections.title: Connected writing and Career Coach
paragraphs: Requested connected writing, tailoring, interview planning, feedback and coach actions send the relevant context through ResumeStudio’s Firebase backend to OpenAI. Dedicated names, phone numbers, email addresses, references and private source-URL fields are omitted from ordinary résumé-writing context. Private photos, signatures, attachment files and reference details are excluded from the redacted page image used for requested coach layout feedback. Text you place in a job description, note or chat may still contain personal information; review it before sending.

The coach can read relevant saved work through named tools. Selected relationship roles, companies, follow-ups and notes may be included when relevant; requested negotiation help can include the compensation and offer amounts you entered. Résumé, application, answer-vault and reminder changes proposed by the coach require your approval.

Coach memories are stored on device and can be reviewed, kept or forgotten; relevant remembered context may be sent with a coach request. The Writing Voice Profile sends a short style brief with tone, length, spelling and preferred or banned phrases. Its saved writing examples remain on device.

privacySections.title: AI résumé import
paragraphs: If you choose connected AI import, the extracted text of the document is sent for structured parsing. That text can contain your name, contact details, employment history and other personal information in the original résumé; ordinary writing redaction does not apply to this import step. The original image or document file is not uploaded for ordinary OCR. Review the proposed imported fields before applying them. Saved AI output can be stored under your Firebase account.

privacySections.title: Recorded answer practice
paragraphs: Single-answer voice practice records to your device. Speech recognition prefers on-device recognition where supported and may use Apple’s speech service when local recognition is unavailable. Choosing connected AI feedback sends the transcript and delivery measurements, rather than the saved audio file, to the writing service.

privacySections.title: Spoken mock interviews
paragraphs: Starting a live spoken interview sends microphone audio directly from your device to OpenAI’s realtime service. ResumeStudio’s Firebase backend issues a short-lived session credential; it does not relay or store the live audio. The transcript is saved on device and can be sent later if you request connected feedback or a debrief.
OpenAI’s provider retention rules apply to live audio and transcripts. ResumeStudio does not promise zero-retention processing. You can stop the session to stop streaming microphone audio.

privacySections.title: Provider processing and retention
paragraphs: ResumeStudio’s text requests disable stored API responses. This does not remove OpenAI’s separate security and abuse-monitoring retention. Under OpenAI’s default API controls, request content may be retained for abuse monitoring for up to 30 days, with exceptions described in its policy. Approved retention controls have not been verified for these sessions. API data is not used for model training by default. See OpenAI’s API data controls at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data.

privacySections.title: iCloud, accounts and service identifiers
paragraphs: If you enable iCloud sync, the workspace archive and associated evidence files are stored in your private iCloud container under your Apple Account. Apple operates that service.

When online, ResumeStudio creates a protected anonymous Firebase account so supported services can work without mandatory signup. Optional email or Sign in with Apple adds account information. Firebase can retain your account identifier, saved AI results, allowance and referral records, signed purchase-verification information, hosted content and its ownership metadata. An installation identifier is sent with service requests and may be hashed for allowance enforcement; it is not an advertising identifier.

privacySections.title: Review Rooms
paragraphs: Publishing a Review Room uploads the selected PDF and rendered page images, together with the room title, message and reviewer context you provide. The PDF may contain the personal information you chose to include. The room uses an unguessable link and access code, expires within 31 days, and can be revoked or deleted by its owner.

Reviewer names, comments, exact suggested edits and sign-off are stored with the room. Suggested edits change your résumé only after you accept them. Deleting the hosted room removes its document, page images and stored feedback.

privacySections.title: Trackable résumé links and public CV pages
paragraphs: A trackable link uploads your selected PDF and page images. Its viewer uses an anonymous per-link visitor cookie and records opens, reading time while the page is visible, PDF downloads and a coarse device/browser hint. This retained engagement data is visible to the sender; the viewer is told about it. ResumeStudio does not identify the visitor by name.

A public CV page contains the résumé and public profile fields you choose to publish. It can be search-indexable when you enable that choice. Owners can withdraw, revoke or delete their hosted pages and links. Removing access does not erase copies a recipient has already downloaded.

privacySections.title: Career Proof Packs
paragraphs: Publishing a Proof Pack uploads its rendered PDF and page images. Before publishing, you choose the evidence and the redactions for employer names, sources, exact dates, attachment previews and referee names. Included attachment previews and personal details become part of the published document; the underlying source files are not uploaded separately.

A Proof Pack uses an unlisted, private-by-link address without viewer analytics. ResumeStudio does not record Proof Pack opens or reading time for its owner. Packs expire after fourteen days by default and no more than 31 days, use no-index headers, and can be revoked or deleted by their owner. Deleting a pack removes its hosted PDF and page images.

privacySections.title: Evidence confirmations and outcome benchmarks
paragraphs: If you request confirmation of one evidence claim, the selected claim and context are hosted behind a one-use link. A referee independently provides their name, role, decision and comment. ResumeStudio does not upload a recipient email or address-book list for this request, and does not verify the identity of the person holding the link. An answered confirmation cannot be edited through ordinary revocation; account erasure removes the owned record.

Outcome benchmarks are a separate opt-in feature. Contributions contain bounded outcome counts and broad role, seniority and market categories rather than résumé text, an employer or a job title. A hashed installation/cohort key replaces a repeat contribution, and a cohort is not published until enough separate contributors are present.

privacySections.title: Purchases
paragraphs: Apple processes purchases and payment details. ResumeStudio receives signed transaction information such as product identifier, status, purchase date and expiration date to unlock access and enforce allowances. ResumeStudio does not receive your payment-card or bank details.

privacySections.title: Privacy-safe product measurement
paragraphs: Anonymous product insights are off by default. If you opt in, the app sends only allow-listed event names, plan tier, AI route, app version and a coarse onboarding goal. Events exclude résumé text, account and installation identifiers, contact details, company names, job descriptions, URLs and advertising identifiers. The backend folds events into aggregate daily counters rather than a per-user activity timeline. Those aggregate records expire after 90 days. Turning insights off stops new submissions; existing anonymous totals are not per-user records.

privacySections.title: Data sharing and tracking
paragraphs: ResumeStudio does not sell personal data, display third-party advertising or track you across other companies’ apps and websites for advertising. Apple, Google/Firebase and OpenAI receive data for the app features described above. Trackable-link engagement is separate from advertising tracking; Proof Packs have no owner-facing viewer analytics.

privacySections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: On-device work remains until you erase it or remove the app. iCloud data remains until you erase the archive. Saved AI work remains in Firebase until you delete it or your account. Hosted access ends on expiry, withdrawal, revocation or deletion; expiry ends access and does not by itself promise immediate physical deletion of every hosted object.

Settings → Account and backup provides separate server-account, local-workspace and iCloud controls. Server-account deletion removes the managed account records, saved AI output, hosted CV pages, résumé links, Review Rooms, Proof Packs and owned evidence confirmations. Local erasure and iCloud erasure are separate choices. Provider security-retention rules may still apply to requests already processed, and downloaded copies remain with their recipients. Deleting an account does not cancel an App Store subscription.

privacySections.title: Children, changes and contact
paragraphs: ResumeStudio is intended for career planning and is not directed to children. Check its current App Store age rating. This policy will be updated before material processing changes take effect.
For privacy, support or deletion questions, email currenttech.co.za@gmail.com.

dataCards.title: Not requested
items: Advertising identifiers or cross-app advertising tracking.
Payment-card or bank-account details.
Background location or a general email-inbox feed.
A bulk upload of your address book.

dataCards.title: Stored on device first
items: Résumés, photos, layouts, versions and exports.
Applications, selected contacts, offers, career evidence and attached source files.
Imported inbox items, interview records, coach conversations and remembered context.
Recorded answer-practice files, transcripts and Writing Voice Profile examples.

dataCards.title: Local processing
items: Apple Vision reads selected screenshots and scanned documents locally.
Eligible lightweight tasks may use Apple Foundation Models on supported devices.
Shared application messages and invites are analyzed locally for review.
Apple speech recognition prefers local processing and may use Apple’s speech service when unavailable.

dataCards.title: Requested connected processing
items: Ordinary writing sends limited redacted context through Firebase to OpenAI.
AI résumé import sends extracted original text, which may include names and contact details.
Live spoken interviews stream microphone audio directly to OpenAI; provider retention applies.
Relevant coach context can include selected relationship notes and compensation amounts entered for negotiation help.

dataCards.title: Hosted sharing you choose
items: Review Rooms host the selected PDF, page images and reviewer feedback behind a link and code.
Trackable links retain opens, visible reading time, downloads and a per-link cookie for sender analytics.
Public CV pages host selected documents and fields and may be search-indexable.
Proof Packs host the reviewed, optionally redacted PDF and page images without owner-facing viewer tracking.
Evidence-confirmation links host the selected claim/context and the referee’s own reply.

dataCards.title: Accounts, sync and purchases
items: Firebase retains the guest or signed-in account, saved AI results, service identifiers, allowances and ownership records.
Apple returns signed purchase status; ResumeStudio receives no payment-card or bank details.
The private iCloud workspace and evidence files sync only when you enable sync.
Server account, local workspace and iCloud erasure are separate controls; account deletion does not cancel subscriptions.

measurement: Anonymous product insights are off by default. Opting in sends only coarse allow-listed event, plan, AI route, version and onboarding-goal values. Identity, account/installation identifiers, content and URLs are excluded; daily aggregate records expire after 90 days. Opting out stops future submissions. Outcome benchmarks are a separate opt-in feature with bounded counts and broad categories.
supportIntro: Get help with documents, accounts, purchases, AI credits, recorded and live interview practice, iCloud sync, public CV pages, trackable links, Review Rooms and Proof Packs.
supportDiagnostic: Include your device model, iOS version, ResumeStudio version and build number, the feature you were using, the exact steps, and the error shown. Attach a screenshot only after checking it contains no résumé or job-search data. Never send passwords, access codes, payment-card details, or a résumé unless you deliberately choose to share it for support.

supportCards.title: Account and data
supportCards.body: Use Settings → Account and backup to reset a password or separately erase your server account, local workspace and iCloud archive. Server-account deletion also removes owned hosted documents, feedback and evidence confirmations. Deleting an account does not cancel an App Store subscription.

supportCards.title: Plans and purchases
supportCards.body: Use Settings → Plans and purchases to restore purchases. Manage or cancel subscriptions through your Apple Account subscription settings. Apple processes payment details; do not send card or bank information to support.

supportCards.title: Offline access
supportCards.body: Editing, preview, export, applications, saved interview work, OCR and supported on-device AI can work offline. Connected AI, live spoken interviews, account changes and hosted features require a connection.

supportCards.title: AI import and writing
supportCards.body: Local OCR previews and connected AI import are separate choices. AI import sends extracted document text, including contact details present in the original; ordinary writing uses limited redacted context. Review imported fields and proposed edits before applying them. Privacy Centre lets you pause AI.

supportCards.title: Voice and spoken interviews
supportCards.body: Recorded answer practice keeps the saved audio file on device; speech recognition may use Apple’s service when local recognition is unavailable. Live spoken interviews stream microphone audio directly to OpenAI and are subject to provider retention. Stop the session to stop audio streaming; only request a debrief when you want to send the transcript for feedback.

supportCards.title: Hosted links and privacy
supportCards.body: Manage CV pages, trackable links, Review Rooms and Proof Packs from their screens to withdraw, revoke or delete access. Trackable links show sender engagement; Proof Packs do not record owner-facing viewer analytics. A downloaded copy remains with its recipient.

supportCards.title: Insights and history
supportCards.body: Anonymous product insights are off by default and can be turned off in Privacy Centre. The optional daily totals contain no account or installation identifier and expire after 90 days. Review or forget coach memories and use the separate local, server and iCloud erasure controls for your saved work.
